name: hwpx-docs-privacy
description: Optional add-on of hwpx-docs: the model sees pseudonyms for what its rules find. Personal data in Hangul documents (resident numbers, phones, addresses, accounts, names, hidden places such as author, title and memos; dictionary terms in strict mode) that its rules find is replaced by tags such as ⟪주민번호1｜1980년대·남⟫ in what `hd` shows; tags are turned back into real values when a document is written. Local vault, hooks, audit log. Off unless installed.
